utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Mina, that’ll be a huge help on Saturday. I’ll make sure we’ve got a spot for you on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — I’ll bring the hammer and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep — I’ll be out front Saturday morning for the repair drive, so just swing by then and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll be there Saturday morning and I’ll bring a couple more neighbors who can help too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it at 10 a.m. on the front porch and make sure the supplies are ready. If anything changes, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — quick update: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll spread the word so everyone has the right details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’m set for 10 a.m. out front on Saturday for the repair drive. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — 10 a.m. out front works well. I appreciate you being there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect — 10 a.m. on the front porch works for me. I’ll be there for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll see you there at 10 with the hammer and work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Saturday morning still works for me, and I’ll be there to help. I’ll also ask a couple more handy neighbors to join us.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wonderful, Sam — thank you! I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows it’s 10 a.m. on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Rosa — I’ll be out front this Saturday morning for the repair drive and I’ll lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik — I’ve got you down for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let everyone know the update.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, then we’re set for 10 a.m. on the front porch. I’ll make sure the supplies are ready and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. 10 a.m. on the front porch works for me, and I appreciate you getting the supplies ready.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
